tagline: Pads, keys, plucks and soundscapes, artist-inspired
description: A two-layer synth for pads, keys, plucks, leads, bells and soundscapes, played from a sunset horizon instead of a wall of knobs: drag the sun for motion and tone, shape the rest with six macros. 109 presets inspired by Tame Impala, Massive Attack, Brent Faiyaz, Mike Dean, Travis Scott, Yeezus, moshc0re, SAFE and trip hop, plus a modelled electric guitar, from bare and soft to extreme.
highlights: Twelve sources per layer: Juno-style analog, string machine, formant choir, FM glass, electric piano, pitched air, sine, plucked string, drawbar organ, mallets (marimba, vibes, kalimba, glock, steel), hard sync and a modelled electric guitar
Electric guitar: a picked string heard through a magnetic pickup (neck to bridge), into the Dirt amp and a CAB speaker (1x12 combo or 4x12 stack); chords strum low to high
Dirt (8 distortion types), tape wow and saturation, lo-fi, Juno / Solina ensemble, phaser, dub delay, shimmer reverb, tempo pump and gate
Drag the sun to set Motion and Tone; Swell, Tail, Blend, Grit, Echo and Space reshape any preset
POLY switch: play chords with any preset, even the mono leads
109 presets: TAME IMPALA, MASSIVE ATTACK, BRENT FAIYAZ, MIKE DEAN, TRAVIS SCOTT, YEEZUS, MOSHC0RE, GUITAR, TRIP HOP, 80S, 2000S, SAFE
TAPE STOP: slow everything to a halt like a tape machine powering down, then automate it at the end of a beat
installTips: Every macro's centre position is the preset as designed: double-click a knob, or the sun, to go back to it.
Pump, gate, delay and synced LFOs follow FL Studio's tempo.
Guitar presets: play chords as voicings within one or two octaves (like a real neck), around C2-C5 in FL's piano roll; the POLY switch must be on for chords.
TAPE STOP: in FL Studio, right-click the switch > Create automation clip, then draw it on where the beat should stop. It stays silent until switched off again.
previewNote: on the same 120 BPM phrase: a held Dm9, an arpeggio over Bb, Fmaj7 stabs, then a legato melody. GUITAR presets play strummed Em, C and G chords at 80 BPM and a riff.

items: 2000s category, 10 new instruments: a Rock Your Body clav, a Neptunes suitcase EP, a Clipse dark stab, the Drop It Like It's Hot chords (subtle), Dr. Dre's In Da Club strings and West Coast piano, Timbaland's Get Ur Freak On tumbi, a Kanye soul-sample chop, a crunk lead and the SexyBack fuzz stab (extreme)

80s category, 10 new instruments: the Push It To The Limit Jupiter lead and sitar-like arpeggio, a DX tine electric piano, an I'm Still Standing piano, funk DI guitar chops, an orchestra hit, poly brass, a Juno pad, a Moroder machine (extreme) and ballad bells (subtle)

New look, matching the rawleads instrument design: a DARK / LITE switch in the top bar (every open plugin follows it, with a soft crossfade), keycap buttons that press in, the preset name on a lit smoked-amber key with a flickering lamp behind it, LED switches, glowing knob arcs, console displays and the Instrument Sans typeface
